      "band": "P1",
      "score": 0.78,
      "reason_tag": "bug fix",
      "rationale": "Fixes a privacy leak where transactions were announced over standard clearnet P2P connections despite `-privatebroadcast`. As noted in the description, 'an incoming dust payment triggering your node to rebroadcast 24-36th later over clearnet' breaks the core privacy expectations of transaction origin privacy."
    },

      "name": "wallet",
      "member": true,
      "evidence": "Carries the 'Wallet' label and modifies transaction rebroadcast logic in src/wallet/wallet.cpp.",
      "band": "P2",
      "score": 0.70,
      "reason_tag": "bug fix",
      "rationale": "Prevents the wallet's periodic resubmission logic from compromising user anonymity. The release notes state that 'a transaction that was broadcast privately and later received back from the network was otherwise announced again from the node's own connections, which revealed its origin.'"
